Issue Identified: Schema validation and whitespace in text columns
Cleaning Action Taken: Trimmed whitespace, verified unique category_id primary keys
Business & Technical Justification: Ensure strict master key referential integrity for downstream joins

Issue Identified: Duplicate customer records introduced during batch ingestion
Cleaning Action Taken: Deduplicated dataset based on unique primary key 'customer_id' (kept first occurrence)
Business & Technical Justification: Prevent demographic bias and double-counting of cardholder profiles

Issue Identified: Inconsistent casing ('mUMBAI', 'bengaluru', 'DELHI') and legacy city aliases
Cleaning Action Taken: Applied `.str.strip().str.title()` and standardized regional city nomenclatures
Business & Technical Justification: Enable reliable geographic grouping and drilldowns in SQL and BI dashboards

Issue Identified: Missing values: 35 nulls in 'annual_income' and 25 nulls in 'city'
Cleaning Action Taken: Imputed missing income via income-tier stratified medians; imputed missing city with modal metropolitan city
Business & Technical Justification: Preserves sample size while eliminating bias; income tier median protects against skewed distribution

Issue Identified: Duplicate card account entries from redundant ETL ingestion batches
Cleaning Action Taken: Deduplicated dataset based on unique 'card_id' token (kept first occurrence)
Business & Technical Justification: Prevent inflated credit exposure calculations and false card counts

Issue Identified: Non-standardized casing in card tier labels ('silver', 'PLATINUM', 'gold')
Business & Technical Justification: Ensures consistent categorical aggregations across SQL and visualization filters

Issue Identified: Missing credit limits (12 rows) and un-synchronized open-to-buy balances
Cleaning Action Taken: Imputed missing limits using card-type median; recalculated open_to_buy as (credit_limit - total_revolving_bal)
Business & Technical Justification: Maintains strict accounting balance consistency across portfolio balances

Issue Identified: Duplicate transaction records caused by network retries and payment gateway replays
Business & Technical Justification: Eliminates artificial spend inflation and distorted merchant transaction counts

Issue Identified: Outlier amounts: 8 negative entries and 4 extreme fat-finger anomalies (>₹5,00,000)
Cleaning Action Taken: Converted negative values to positive magnitudes (`.abs()`); capped extreme fat-finger outliers to category upper limits
Business & Technical Justification: Eliminates distorted portfolio spend totals and preserves accurate average ticket size metrics

Issue Identified: Mixed date formatting standards (DD/MM/YYYY vs ISO YYYY-MM-DD) across regional terminal POS logs
Cleaning Action Taken: Standardized all date strings into uniform ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format
Business & Technical Justification: Required for chronological ordering, monthly time-series aggregation, and date-diff window calculations

Issue Identified: Missing payment channel metadata (75 null records)
Cleaning Action Taken: Imputed missing values with modal channel ('POS Swipe')
Business & Technical Justification: Ensures full attribution in channel-distribution metrics without dropping valid revenue transactions

Issue Identified: Referential integrity audit against parent master tables (`cards` and `categories`)
Cleaning Action Taken: Verified 100% of foreign keys resolve to valid parent table primary keys
Business & Technical Justification: Guarantees relational database consistency and prevents orphan records
